Footer

Configure footer text that appears at the bottom of expense claims.

Use footers to add terms, conditions, or additional information to expense claims.

Name

Enter a name to identify this footer template.

Content

Enter the footer text that will appear at the bottom of expense claims. You can use formatting and multiple lines.

Inactive

Check this box to deactivate this footer. It won't appear in selection lists but existing expense claims will retain it.
